Record Class RabbitMqConsumerInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.controlpanel.panels.rabbitmq.RabbitMqConsumerInfo
Record Components:
queue - the queue name
listener - the listener class
method - the method name
connection - the connection name
executor - the executor name, or null for the consumer executor of the connection
consumers - the number of consumers, as configured
prefetch - the prefetch count, or 0 for no limit
autoAcknowledgment - whether messages are acknowledged as soon as they are delivered
reQueue - whether rejected messages are requeued
exclusive - whether the consumers are exclusive
public record RabbitMqConsumerInfo(String queue, String listener, String method, String connection, @Nullable String executor, String consumers, int prefetch, boolean autoAcknowledgment, boolean reQueue, boolean exclusive) extends Record
A @Queue consumer method of a @RabbitListener. Internal to the RabbitMQ panel views.
Since:
2.3.0
Author:
Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal
